stages.criteria_note: one criterion per stage, and for the KC somata one per set of recordings (kc_soma_criteria): CRITERIA's kc_soma is the APL16 somata's

units.baseline-noise SD: window mean minus pre-odor mean over the SD of the pre-odor frames
units.trial-noise SD: trial mean over the robust SD of single trials about their odor means (1.4826 MAD, residuals scaled by sqrt(n/(n-1)))

stages.orn_recordings: the ORN recordings are of the ORNs' axon terminals in the antennal lobe (pebbled > GCaMP6f), not of their somata or dendrites

megamat_stage_error.combine: root mean square of the stages' population errors (the goal text)
megamat_stage_error.over_wirings: a model's value is the mean over its wirings of each wiring's megamat stage error
beside: the three-view value (every stage's population error on strength, sharing and breadth)
the value of the wirings' mean views (the error common to the wirings)
megamat_stage_error.why: a model right only up to a relabelling of glomeruli is wrong, and the three unit-free views cannot see it
megamat_stage_error.caution: one curve for all glomeruli cannot absorb glomerulus-specific signal strength: if the PN dendrites' class differs with and without the matrix view, the write-up says so
megamat_stage_error.not_readable: a stage that is not readable stays out until a reading holds (the goal text)

split_halves.pairing: each split pairs a random half of the control recordings with a random half of the TNT recordings
split_halves.rule: when a half is scored, everything the reading takes from the flies comes from that half
split_halves.apl_off: the curve is set on the control half; the noise and the reference come from the TNT half
beside: the shared curve: curve and noise from all recordings, the half's one-fly units, on the same variants and splits
all recordings' one-fly units (--units-from all), on the same variants and splits
split_halves.consistency: Spearman's rho over the variants between the two halves' values, the mean over splits
split_halves.reduced_draw: a seeded draw of at least 500 variants and 100 splits if the full run would pass an hour, fixed beforehand and written in the provenance
split_halves.why: a second set of flies would set its own curve; with the curve from all recordings both halves score a model already read against all of them

step_class.distance: per part, the root mean square over the part's entries of the model's change minus the flies' measured change
step_class.inside_if: the distance is no larger than the 95th percentile of the same distance for resampled flies (both stages resampled, as kcq.population_fit.step_interval draws them)
step_class.view_inside_if: every part of the view is inside
step_class.explained_if: every view is inside on 6 of the 8 wirings
step_class.other_classes: "no better than no step" if the model's downstream error is at or above the no-step yardstick, otherwise "in part" (the entry)
step_class.description: the per-entry 90 % intervals stay as the description (the entries inside, e.g. '7 of 15')
step_class.why: with 136 pairs and 90 % intervals even resampled flies miss about one entry in ten, so "every entry inside" can never hold

A_wiring_check.rule: passes if the mean over the eight wirings is 1.2 or less, each wiring scored against the other seven read as the flies, in the seven's own one-fly units
A_wiring_check.replaces: atlas's stub, every wiring at 1.2 or less: the most atypical fly is above 1.2 in 12 of 13 populations of flies_table.md

B_reading.rule: the gate is read on the default reading, with halves as in split_halves, on both conditions; "usable" needs 0.8 in each
beside: the raw reading (two or more spikes, no curve, no noise)
B_reading.why: halves of four TNT recordings are the nearest stand-in for the megamat claws and somata, which have four flies in all

gate.otherwise: each view is tested singly, the views at 0.8 or more form the measure, and the goal text goes back to Tom and Yang (the entry)
